Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Cloud Product Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first (within Germany), but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As a Senior Cloud Product Manager at Contabo, you're stepping into a role that doesn't come around often: you help build a new product from the ground up – a greenfield venture inside an established company, expanding our portfolio into a new market segment. You are the voice of the market and our customers: you establish feedback channels with customer and support teams, translate market and customer needs into a compelling product vision, and take end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap – from high-level planning through prioritisation to delivery, in close alignment with our PMO.

You work in a small, focused team of experts where speed matters: build fast, test fast, learn fast – with AI tools firmly embedded in our daily work, enabling the pace a venture like this demands. You refine ideas until the development teams can implement them with confidence, sequence roadmap items for maximum impact, and shape the best possible user experience together with your UX tandem partner. You don't shy away from technical discussions – you seek them out: you understand the product architecture across the full stack and keep asking "why" until even hidden blockers are on the table – and resolved quickly.

Because the product is new but the company isn't, you hook into existing processes – in finance and infrastructure, for example – and build new ones where gaps remain. You present progress and updates to stakeholders across development, sales, support, marketing, and leadership, acting as their central point of contact. In the medium term, you establish a product-driven roadmap spanning at least two years, along with KPIs that make the platform's success measurable. The role is built for a high degree of autonomy: you report directly to the Head of Product and work independently, driven by results – with no micromanagement, in either direction.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:
• Extensive senior-level experience in product management, ideally in a cloud or IT infrastructure environment
• Proven end-to-end ownership of a product roadmap – from strategy through to delivery, not just in a supporting role
• A solid technical understanding of cloud-native architecture (containers, Kubernetes, microservices, cloud infrastructure) – you can hold your own in discussions with developers
• Experience with data-driven prioritisation and A/B testing, as well as agile frameworks (Scrum or similar)
• Proven experience acting as the central point of contact between engineering, sales, support, and leadership
• Confident, natural use of AI tools in your daily work – from product ideation to everyday tasks
• A high degree of independence and composure in a greenfield environment full of ambiguity – you don't need a task list, you create it
• The ability to quickly build deep understanding of new domains, products, and technologies
• Experience with pricing and packaging (a plus)
• Professional fluency in English (our working language); German language skills, product management certifications (e.g. CSPO, Pragmatic Institute), and a degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering are a plus

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. What you`ll build:

The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. The PhD Graduate Team is responsible for building the bridge between cutting-edge research and SAP functional teams. Our mission is to facilitate the application of research across SAP and contribute to SAP research strategy with interdisciplinary research activities.

Working together with the SAP Autonomous Suite CX team, focusing on customer satisfaction by increasing the predictability of the semester plans, you will bring perspectives and insights from large-scale agile and software development research to our product delivery planning, enhancing SAP’s strategic position in the Autonomous Suite and the innovation speed, and bridging the gap between industry and academia.

In your daily work you will be bridging data science and engineering to turn development data into actionable insights — accelerating team flow, predictability, and customer satisfaction across SAP Commerce release cycles, collaborating with industry experts, researchers, and business stakeholders.

- Review metrics health at team, product, and portfolio level to surface bottlenecks and delivery risks early
- Embed retrospective learnings into process standards, creating a continuous improvement loop across Commerce teams
- Pilot AI-assisted tooling to improve planning accuracy, effort estimation, and workflow automation
- Share engineering excellence practices across squads and teams to accelerate adoption of predictable delivery patterns
- Bridge the gap between academic findings and industry
- Participate in interdisciplinary research activities with the PhD graduate team, supporting SAP’s research strategy
- Be an active part of research mentoring programs and the research community at SAP
- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations
- Research background (publications preferred) in the field of innovation (incl. AI adoption) in software development models, scrum, agile, adoption or other development models
- Proven track record of applied industry-academic research related to agile contexts (conferences like IEEE CBI, publications preferred)
- Experience leading research projects and delivering data-driven recommendations in collaboration with industry partners
- Hands-on technical skills including data analysis, LLM and AI-assisted prototyping, and working with engineering telemetry data (e.g. Jira) to generate delivery insights, programming skills preferred (python, Java, JavaScript)
- Demonstrated ability to manage industry-academic partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives, and co-organizing large-scale events
- Ability to work on challenging research topics with a structured, scientific approach
- Sound understanding of SAP’s product strategy and the Autonomous Enterprise
- Experience integrating AI assistants in workflows, incl. quality assurance.
- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

Where you belong:

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

The PhD Graduate Team stands for embedding cutting-edge research into functional teams across SAP, bringing together interdisciplinary PhD talent in a research-like environment.

- Internal Stakeholder Management: You act as the central point of contact, providing clear communication and aligning expectations across all internal departments involved in product development.

YOUR PROFILE

- Manufacturing and Material Expertise: You are a proactive, solution-oriented project manager with deep expertise in advanced materials and manufacturing processes.
- Educational Background: A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a similar technical field is essential.
- Technical Expertise: You are quickly able to understand difficult technical problems and can challenge your project team on their decisions. You can guide the team to making sensible technical decisions and are comfortable with making technical decisions if needed.

About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead the development of the AI-based “Scientific Brain” research platform, including the overall construction of AI systems; apply large language models (LLMs) to design and optimize model architectures, carry out model training, and deploy the integrated AI platform.
2. Utilize robotic technologies to perform high-throughput experiments for the rapid synthesis and screening of a vast array of material candidates, accelerating the discovery of high-performance materials.
3. Analyze experimental data from material characterization techniques; correlate material properties with catalytic performance to guide the optimization of catalyst formulations and synthesis methods, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency.
4. Apply AI-driven computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level; simulate adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways of reactants, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.
5. Continuously explore and apply new AI algorithms and techniques to optimize predictive models and improve catalyst development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of advanced catalysts.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field
2. Several years of relevant professional experience in AI system development, platform engineering, or a comparable field
3. Solid experience in developing AI systems or scalable platforms, with sound knowledge of distributed system architectures and large-scale data processing
4. Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go
5. Practical experience with common AI frameworks and infrastructure tools, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker
6. Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and containerized deployment technologies
7. Additional academic or professional background in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering is considered an asset
8. Knowledge of or experience in energy, energy storage, or low-carbon technology applications is highly desirable
9. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment: Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe
